_comment: Parameters of the Dixon-Coles rating model and the Monte Carlo simulation. promoted_prior comes from `python -m tablegenius.calibrate`.
promoted_prior_note: Mean full-season rating of the 41 teams promoted into the five leagues in 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 (standard error about 0.03).
xg_weight_note: Share of expected goals blended into each current-season match's goals when football-data.co.uk publishes xG (2026-27 files onward). 0 = off. Leave off until a completed season with xG has been backtested.
prior_strength_note: Chosen from a 2025-26 backtest: 3 and 6 scored almost identically, 6 was slightly better calibrated in the 80-95% range.
time_decay_note: xi 0.0012 and 0.0025 were backtested on 2025-26 and scored no better than 0.0018.
promoted_prior_by_league_note: Per-league priors (shrunk league estimates from `calibrate`) were backtested on 2025-26 and scored slightly worse than the pooled prior (skill vs table-only 17.6% vs 18.1%), so they are not used. Add a `promoted_prior_by_league` block {CODE: {attack, defence}} to try again.
